explication: LLM4Decompile is a research codebase for generating C source from Linux x86_64 binaries or assembly, with evaluation, training, and a newer two-phase SK²Decompile workflow. The principal path prompts a model with assembly, generates source, then measures whether it compiles and runs. The README also documents Ghidra-based pseudo-code refinement and SK² structure recovery followed by identifier naming. Source excerpts establish several implementation links; other capabilities and links are represented only where the README or source index supports them.
